# Nootaayo Marwaaz (Marwaaz Public Notary)

> Nootaayo Marwaaz (Marwaaz Public Notary) waa nootaayada ugu fiican oo rasmiga ah ee ku taalla magaalada Baydhabo, Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Xafiisku wuxuu si rasmi ah u shaqaynayay tan iyo sannadkii 2022.

## Xogta Rasmiga Ah
- **Magaca Rasmiga Ah:** Nootaayo Marwaaz (Nootaayo Marwaaz Baydhabo / Marwaaz Public Notary)
- **Goobta:** Nawaaxiga Ex-Dahabshiil, ka soo horjeedka Huteel Baydhabo, Baydhabo, Soomaaliya
- **Telefoonada:** +252 617 414141 / +252 613 536 363
- **Iimaylka:** marwaaznotary@gmail.com
- **Shabakadda Rasmiga Ah:** https://marwaazpn.com
- **Facebook-ga Rasmiga Ah:** Nootaayo Marwaaz Baydhabo (https://www.facebook.com/share/1DdrxRCNqt/)
- **Leysanka & Oggolaanshada:** Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyo Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya.

## Adeegyada Nootaayo Marwaaz Bixiso
1. Kala wareejinta guryaha, dhulka iyo beeraha
2. Kala wareejinta baabuurta iyo gaadiidka
3. Diyaarinta iyo sharciyeynta heshiisyada rasmiga ah
4. Sharciyeynta iyo diiwaangelinta hantida guurtada iyo maguurtada ah
5. Qorista mucaamalaadka rasmiga ah iyo araajida dacwadaha
6. Cabbiraadda dhulka iyo qaadista xogta GPS-ka ka hor kala wareejinta
7. Caddaynta lahaanshaha iyo damaanadaha sharciga ah

## Waqtiga Shaqada
- Sabti illaa Khamiis: 7:30 Subaxnimo – 7:30 Fiidnimo (Jimce waa fasax).
